cq_coverage.1: CQ1 (What invoices are all listed in an EDIFACT message?): Interchange (containsMessage) -> Message (InvoiceMessage)
cq_coverage.2: CQ2 (Which organizations are involved in the invoice?): InvoiceMessage (hasRoleAssignment) -> OrganizationRoleAssignment (assignedOrganization) -> Organization
cq_coverage.3: CQ3 (What role does organization S play in the invoice?): OrganizationRoleAssignment (assignedOrganization, assignedRole)
cq_coverage.4: CQ4 (Which organization is the buyer in the invoice?): OrganizationRoleAssignment (assignedRole=Buyer, assignedOrganization)
cq_coverage.5: CQ5 (What information is displayed about the involved organizations?): Organization (hasAddress, globalLocationNumber)
cq_coverage.6: CQ6 (What is the address of the buyer?): OrganizationRoleAssignment (assignedRole=Buyer, assignedOrganization) -> Organization (hasAddress) -> Address
cq_coverage.7: CQ7 (What items are sold in the invoice?): InvoiceDetail (hasLineItem) -> LineItem (soldItem) -> Item
cq_coverage.8: CQ8 (What information is displayed about the items sold?): LineItem (soldItem) -> Item
cq_coverage.9: CQ9 (What is the net price of the items sold in the invoice?): LineItem (hasPrice) -> Price (netPrice)
cq_coverage.10: CQ10 (What are the invoice details of the invoice?): InvoiceHeader, InvoiceDetail, InvoiceSummary
cq_coverage.11: CQ11 (What is the invoice amount of the invoice?): InvoiceSummary (invoiceAmount)
cq_coverage.12: CQ12 (What is the invoice number?): InvoiceHeader (invoiceNumber)
cq_coverage.13: CQ13 (What information must be provided so that the file format is valid?): InvoiceHeader (invoiceNumber, documentDate), Organization (globalLocationNumber)
cq_coverage.14: CQ14 (To which business process can the invoice be assigned?): InvoiceMessage (partOfProcess) -> BusinessProcess

pitfalls.name: Inverse relationships not explicitly declared
pitfalls.description: This pitfall appears when any relationship (except for those that are defined as symmetric properties using owl:SymmetricProperty) does not have an inverse relationship (owl:inverseOf) defined within the ontology.

iterations.fix_plan: Add owl:inverseOf for all object properties except those that should be asymmetric. Add inverse property declarations for affected properties.
